roleContext.jobDescription: The regulatory reporting change portfolio delivers the changes the bank's regulators require to its returns each year. The Project Manager runs the projects in that portfolio under the bank's change framework: the plan and the budget, the steering committee reporting, the dependency management with the reporting platform and finance, and the project closure with the regulator's deadline evidence. The portfolio requires the PMP credential, held at the time of hire, because the change framework audit lists it for every project manager on regulatory work, plus four years of financial services project management. Reports to the head of regulatory change; works with the reporting platform team, finance, compliance and the regulatory liaison team.

requirements.text: Holds the PMP credential at the time of hire.
Has at least four years of financial services project management under a formal change framework.
Runs the plan, the budget and the steering committee reporting for each project.
Manages dependencies with the reporting platform and finance under the change framework.
Documents project boundaries and the regulator's deadline evidence at closure.

candidate.originalCvMarkdown:
# Curriculum vitae

Target role: Project Manager, Regulatory Reporting Change

## Experience

- Project manager in the regulatory reporting change team of a mid-sized bank for four years, running six projects under the bank's change framework, each with its plan, budget and monthly steering committee report.
- Completed the 35 contact hours of project management education in 2025 and scheduled the PMP exam for November 2026; the application was accepted by the institute in July 2026.
- Managed the dependencies with the reporting platform team and finance on each project through the framework's dependency log, escalating two platform slips to the portfolio board.
- Wrote the project closure reports with the project boundary statement and the regulator's deadline evidence, all six accepted by the change framework office.
- Before the bank, two years as a project coordinator at an insurer on a claims system replacement.

## Work samples

- Work sample: the plan, the budget tracker and the closure report for one regulatory project, with the change framework office's acceptance reference as a verification trail, and the institute's application acceptance email.
